brief: Temple-front Greek Revival house of 1847: a one-and-a-half-storey gable-front main block behind a full portico of four fluted columns, with lower side wings under their own porches. Painted white clapboard with dark shutters; a showpiece on the bluff street.

facade.notes: the Swartout House (Waukegan IL, 1847): a one-and-a-half-storey Greek temple: a full pediment carried on four fluted Doric columns across the front, a side-hall door with a transom, long shuttered windows to the porch floor, potted shrubs; a small wing

why.note: the miniature Greek temple house: the 1840s ideal, at cottage scale
